cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Are We Now?
cards.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort myself out when I visit. Shall I bring a towel, or are we still using the old arrangement?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use one here. No need to bring everything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, I'll keep the bag small. Guest towel, or the one that used to be mine? I can fit in with either system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours is still on the hook. I haven't moved it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, I'll use that one and leave the bathroom tidy. When I finish, do I put it back on my hook or in the guest laundry? I'll follow whichever arrangement you're keeping.
